identity_status.description: Identity enrichment result for the routed primary product.

confidence.description: Overall identity confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

route_conflict.description: True when router_result selected a category/type that conflicts with the primary product.

primary_object_confidence.description: Primary object confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

category_code.description: Routed or corrected catalog category code for the primary object.

category_confidence.description: Category confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

browse_node_code.description: Routed or corrected browse node code when available; otherwise null.

item_type.description: Routed or corrected product type anchor.

item_type_confidence.description: Item type confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

visible_brand.description: Brand visibly present on the primary product, its tag/label, or own primary packaging.

visible_brand_confidence.description: Visible brand confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

brand.description: Search brand anchor for the primary object.

brand_confidence.description: Brand confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

brand_candidates.description: Ranked plausible brand candidates for UI chips/search expansion when exact brand is uncertain.

family.description: Product line/family for rich-identity goods; otherwise null.

family_confidence.description: Family confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

family_candidates.description: Ranked plausible product family/line candidates for UI chips/search expansion when exact family is uncertain.

model.description: Exact model only when strongly supported.

model_confidence.description: Exact model confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

model_candidates.description: Ranked plausible exact model candidates. These are suggestions, not hard filters.

color.description: Dominant retrieval-relevant product color, or null.

color_confidence.description: Color confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

visual_attributes.description: Visible similarity/search attributes for the primary product, such as primary_color, print_text, pattern, material, shape, package_text, or visible_label_text.

needs_more_photos.description: True when another view would materially improve identity or resolve route conflict.

confidence.description: Candidate confidence from 0 to 1, or null.
Candidate confidence from 0 to 1, or null.
Candidate confidence from 0 to 1, or null.

code.description: Attribute code, e.g. primary_color, secondary_color, print_text, pattern, graphic_theme, material, shape, form_factor, package_text, visible_label_text.

text.description: Text value when kind is text.

number.description: Numeric value when kind is number.

bool.description: Boolean value when kind is bool.

confidence.description: Attribute confidence from 0 to 1, or null.
